description: Two figures in ancient East Asian-style robes stand on a rickety rope bridge over a churning, storm-dark sea under swirling clouds. The man on the left, with a topknot, grips a jewelled spear whose tip drips water into the waves. The woman on the right, with long black hair, holds a long jewelled staff. No text, frame or border is visible; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
